header_sentences: See Celestial Good, and see Forehead, Mountain, and Oil.

contexts.text: Oil of olive... = all the Celestial, thus all the good of love and of charity. Illustrated.

For the good of love from the Lord continually inflows, through the internal man into the external; but the man who is in the affection of evil... perverts the good; but still the life thence remains. Explained. AC 7491. AC 7492.
In proportion as the good of love and of charity is in the affection of good and the pleasure thence derived, it is celestial, and it is happy.
(The decline of the Most Ancient Church from the good of love.)
If he has lived in the goods of love and of charity, the Lord then separates evils, and through the goods with him elevates him into Heaven.
No one is admitted into... Heaven unless he is in the good of love and of charity; and no one can be in the good of love and of charity unless he acknowledges the Divine and the Holy of the Lord...
The good of love is what makes the Celestial Church; and the good of faith, the Spiritual Church, The truth of faith does not make it, but introduces.
In the good of love from the Lord there is celestial life; but not in the truth of faith separated thence.
Under Judah, see this reference. AC 3654:6. AC 4750. AC 9340:10.
Worship from the good of faith when the spiritual regenerate are treated of, and worship from the good of love when the celestial regenerate are treated of. Signified. AC 2826:11.
Spiritual heat, which is the good of love... AC 3969:16. AC 6190:2. AC 8487. AC 8750:2. AC 10188:3.
Bread = the good of love in general, both celestial and spiritual...
To dwell in the house of Jehovah = to he and to live in the good of love.
Not to dwell in the land of Jehovah = not to lie in a state of the good of love, thus not in the Lord's Kingdom.
Those who are imbued with the good of love to the Lord, and with the good of innocence. Signified.
Removal from a state of the good of love and of innocence. Signified.

Of the good of love and of faith they have no other idea than that they are certain abstract things devoid of power to effect anything; when yet the contrary is the case; namely, that thence come all perception and sensation, and all life and action...
In () it treats of the state of the Church... as to the ascent from the truth of faith to the good of love.
Jehovah is mentioned when it treats of the good of love, which is of the celestial man.
Under Wheat, see this reference.
The reason they can be saved, is that the Divine of the Lord is in the good of love to God and the good of charity towards the neighbour...

Moreover, the good of love to God, and the good of charity towards the neighbour, however various truths may be... are still receptible of genuine good and truth; for they are... not hard and resisting, but as it were soft and yielding...
Red = the good of love; and white, the truth of faith, AC 6379.
Altar = the good of love.
Worship from the good of love. Signified.
Mountain = the good of love. AC 4213:end.
For the good of love and of charity gives peace.
They who are in the Grand Man are in the freedom of breathing when they are in the good of love...
The order of Heaven is the disposition of the truths of faith in the goods of charity... and the disposition of these in the good of love to the Lord.
(Thus) no faith is ever possible except with those who are in the good of love...
The Most Ancient Church, being celestial, was in the good of love to the Lord, and thence in the perception of all truth...

There are two universal kinds of good, one which is called the good of faith, and the other which is called the good of love. The good of faith is signified by drink-offering; and the good of love by oil. They who are brought to good by the Lord by an internal way are in the good of love; but they who are brought by an external way are in the good of faith. The men of the Celestial Church and the Angels of the Third Heaven are in the good of love; but the men of the Spiritual Church and the Angels of the Second Heaven are in the good of faith. Hence it is that the former is called celestial good, and the latter spiritual good. The difference is that which there is between willing well from willing well, and willing well from understanding well. AC 4750:3.
To give the sun for the light of the day = the good of love and of charity.
All loins = all goods of love.
The celestial man is regenerated through the good of love.
From their faces shines forth the good of love through the truth of faith...
The resplendence of their garments is from the good of love and of charity...
Body = the good of love. Explained.
For the good of love is like a flame which emits a light from itself which is the derivative truth of faith.
That gold, fire, lightning, and brass = the good of love. References. AC 8496.
To do mercy = the good of love.
The good of love is inseparable from the truth of faith.
Lion = the good of love and the derivative truth in its power.
Wine = the good of love towards the neighbour and the good of faith. Illustrated.
The bread = the good of celestial love...
That the good of love and the good of faith ceased. Treated of.
Oil = the good of celestial love... AC 8468:2.
The blood of grapes = the good of love.
Girt about the paps with a golden girdle = the good of love.

The internal good of the Celestial Kingdom is the good of love to the Lord, and its external good is the good of mutual love. They who are of this Kingdom are in the good of love, but not in the truth which is called the truth of faith... for in the place of the truth of faith with them, there is the good of mutual love.
Fruit = the good of love. AC 9031:4.
They who are in the good of love and of charity are, as to the internal man, in Heaven...

As the human race removed from the good of love to the Lord and of charity towards the neighbour, it also in the same proportion removed from wisdom, because in the same proportion it removed from Heaven.
The sun = the good of celestial love. References.
Conjunction in the good of love there. Signified, Explained.
Zion = the Celestial Church, thus the good of love which is of this Church.

The good of love and of charity, in its origin... is very kind... but when it falls down to the Hells it becomes unkind and savage, because it is turned into this by them; and therefore the influx of this Divine good not only torments them, but also devastates them.
Roast with fire = the good of love.
The paschal lamb = the good of innocence, which good is the good of love to the Lord.
Raw = without the good of love.
Edom = the good of celestial love.
For Heaven is Heaven from the good of love. AC 8410.
That after temptation the truths of faith were ordinated through the good of love. Signified, Explained.
Under Flesh, see this reference. AC 8682:2. AC 9127:2.
Without such a change of states the good of celestial love would become as it were dry...
For the good of love and of faith is the image of the Lord.
They who are in the good of love and of faith are in correspondence; and the Divine makes all things with them...
Worship from the good of love and the truths of faith. Signified, Explained.
Hence it is that the Angels are alternately in the good of love, in the truth of faith, and in obscurity as to both... A state of the good of love corresponds to morning...
I have brought you to Me = to the good of love, which is in Heaven.
Because the good of love in the higher Heaven is relatively like a consuming fire...
They stood in the lower parts of the mount = far from the good of celestial love.
To them that love Me = who receive the good of love.
That then there is peace and the good of love. Signified, Explained.
As soon as the good of love is implanted, combat ceases... For he is then introduced into Heaven, and is led by the Lord according to the laws of order there.
To bless = to endow with the good of love. References.
Man = the good of love. References.
The good of love from the Lord is universally regnant in Heaven, and inflows constantly according to the degree in which it is shown to another.
The goods of love make the life of the will.
See Good of Faith.
There are two things which make Heaven, and thus spiritual life with man, the truth of faith in the Lord, and the good of love to Him.
Just is predicated of the good of love towards the neighbour; and innocent of the good of love to the Lord; the former is exterior good, and the latter is interior good. Explained.
For the Lord is in the good of love, and through it in the truth of faith.
Oliveyard = the Celestial Church, thus celestial good, which is the good of love to the Lord; for this good makes the Celestial Church.
That from Him is all the good of love and truth of faith. Signified, Explained.
For the good of love is such, that what is in it is also in others from it; because it is communicative of itself...
Increase of the good of love and truth of faith. Signified, Explained.
The Lord's guard and providence lest he should be approached except through the good of love. Signified.
Heavenly food is all the good of love and of charity.
Divine truth in Heaven itself resplendent from the good of love. Signified, Explained.
In the Inmost Heaven there reigns the good of love to the Lord... AC 9670.
The internal in the Celestial Kingdom is the good of love to the Lord, and the external is the good of mutual love. Signified.
Under Good, see this reference.
The hearing and reception of all things of worship from the good of love. Signified, Explained.
See Cherub. AC 9509. AC 9509:3. AC 9517. AE 179:5.
All the good of love is from the Lord, and is the Lord Himself with Angel and man.
All the good of love is from mercy. Signified.
The light of the Celestial Kingdom or of the Inmost Heaven appears as flame; the reason is that in that Heaven reigns the good of love...
The third degree is opened by a life according to the good of mutual love and the good of love to the Lord.
See East. AC 9668:2. HH 148.
The Lord enters Heaven through the good of love; and the good of love from the Lord fills Heaven and makes it. Signified.
The goods of love and of faith conjoined there. Signified, Explained.

The good of love to the Lord in the Inmost Heaven is the internal good there, and the good of mutual love is the external good there; but the good of charity towards the neighbour is the internal in the Middle Heaven, and the good of faith in the Lord is the external good there.
For they who are conjoined with the Lord through the good of love are with Him; but they who are conjoined with the Lord through the good of faith are indeed with Him, but more remotely.
The hearing and reception of all things which are of worship from the good of love in the Inmost Heaven from the Lord. Signified, Explained.
They who are in the good of love to the Lord are they who proximately receive His influx...
It treats in () of the worship of the Lord from the good of love.

There are three goods which follow in order, - the good of faith, the good of charity towards the neighbour, and the good of love to the Lord; the good of faith makes the First Heaven; the good of charity towards the neighbour makes the Second Heaven; and the good of love to the Lord makes the Third Heaven.

In the internal of the Celestial Kingdom are those who are in the good of love to the Lord, and in its external are those who are in the good of mutual love; but in the internal of the Spiritual Kingdom are those who are in the good of charity towards the neighbour, and in its external are those who are in the good of faith; it is the external of each [Kingdom] which is called the First Heaven.
All good is of love, even the good of faith; for this exists from the good of love, and not without it.
Divine celestial good, which makes the Third Heaven, is the good of love to the Lord...
The influx of the Lord through the Word into all who are in the good of love. Signified, Explained.
All truths are implanted in the good of love.
The heavenly form of all Truths in their order in the memory from the good of love. Signified, Explained.
A workman of stone = the good of love, thus the Voluntary of the regenerate.

There is one good from which are all truths; this good is the good of love to the Lord, thus the Lord Himself; and thence the good of love from the Lord, which is the good of love to the Lord. Explained.
That each and all things, in general and in particular, proceed from the good of love from the Lord to the Lord. Signified, Explained.
That this (Divine good which proceeds from the Lord) is the good of love from the Lord to the Lord. Explained.
Hence it is that they who are in the good of love to the Lord, and thence in the truths of faith, are in the freest state of willing and thinking...
Under Anoint, see this reference. AC 9954. AC 10019. AR 779:2. AE 329:24. AE 1151.
That when nakedness relates to the loins and genitals, it = the deprivation of the good of love. Illustrated.
For what proceeds from the Lord and inflows into the Heavens is the good of love; and what is received there by the Angels is the truth thence...
Under Celestial, see this reference.
See Celestial Kingdom.
To worship the devil from the good of celestial love. Signified.
As the things which succeed in order proceed from the good of love to the Lord...
The head with man corresponds to the good of love to the Lord, which is the good of the Inmost Heaven, and is called Divine celestial good...
The good of love is what immediately conjoins man with the Divine...
The Lord is present with every man with the good of love...
The good of love to the Lord from the Lord is in all the good of charity which is genuine; and also in all the good of faith which is genuine; for it inflows from the Lord. Explained, Signified.
For the good of love is the vital fire itself; and the truth of faith is the intellectual light itself... These two proceed in equal degree.
Under Altar, see this reference. AC 10344. AR 325, etc.
The good of love is formed through the truths of the Church which are from the Word; at first the external ones; afterwards, more and more interior ones. Signified.
(Thus) in such a perception and affection, and in such an order, as a man imbues truths, such is the good of love with him. Explained.
Those who are in the good of love with whom the Church is to be established. Signified, Explained.
To represent all things of faith being of service to the good of love. Signified, Explained.
The Lord's body or flesh = the good of love; in like manner the bread.
To a land flowing with milk and honey = the pleasantness and delight from the good of love and of faith.
The goods which affect delightfully are called those of love.
Under Bread, see this reference.
The Divine good which is compared to heat is the good of love with the Angels; and the Divine truth which is compared to light is that through which and from which is the good of love.

Because the good of love and of faith is what makes Heaven; and this good is in every Society of Heaven, and in every Angel of a Society. It makes no difference that this good is everywhere different and various; it is still the good of Heaven...

To those who receive Him in the good of love He appears as a Sun, fiery and flaming according to the reception; these are in His Celestial Kingdom... The reason is that the good of love corresponds to fire.
Under Gold, see this reference. AR 211. AR 904. AR 912. AR 912:2. AR 913.

The celestial Angels are in the good of love from the Lord; and the spiritual Angels are in truths of wisdom from Him; and where there is the good of love, there resides wisdom at the same time; but where there are truths, there resides no more of wisdom than in proportion to the good of love... This is the reason why in the Word of the Celestial Kingdom... the goods of love are expressed, and the signs are affections; whereas in the Word of the Spiritual Kingdom truths of wisdom are expressed, and the signs are perceptions.
I will give to eat of the tree of life = the appropriation of the good of love and of charity from the Lord. Explained. AE 109.
Their false assertion that they have the good of love. Signified, Explained.
Under Eat, see this reference.
Lest the good of celestial love be profaned and adulterated. Signified.
That all the good of love and truth of faith had receded. Signified, Explained.
That there was shown the quality of the New Church from doctrine, that all things of it were from the good of love. Signified, Explained.
That all things of Heaven and the Church are from the good of love; and that the good of love is from the Lord. Explained.
That this heat... inflows into man's will, and produces there the good of love; and this light into his understanding, and produces there the truth of wisdom. General article.
All good of love is an image of the Lord.
John = those who are in the good of love.
The good of love to the Lord is the Lord Himself.
As the good of love does not act from itself, but through truths, all power is from the good of love through truths; and, with the spiritual, from the good of charity through the truths of faith...
The guard and providence of the Lord lest the interior Heavens should be approached except by the good of love and of charity. Signified, Explained.
The good of love inflows from the Lord alone; and is received by Angels and men in the truths which are from the Word...
For what love itself wills is the good of love.
That all the good of love had disappeared. Signified, Explained. AE 405. AE 915.

There are three things which fully constitute and form every universal essential, namely, the good of love, truth from this good, and the derivative good of life... The good of love is the final cause; truth from that good is the efficient cause... and the good of life is the effect in which the prior causes exist...
The good of love is like the heart; and is also meant by heart in the Word; truth from that good is like the lungs... and the good of life is like the body...
The two witnesses = the good of love and of charity, and the truth of doctrine and of faith. Explained. AE 638.
All the worship of Jehovah God must be from the good of love through truths; the worship which is from the good of love alone is not worship... there must be both...

There is indeed conjunction with Him through the good of love; but as the Lord inflows with man through good into truths... and man receives the good of the Lord in truths... therefore the good of love conjoins through truth...
This trine... is in every Heaven... the end is the good of love; the cause is truth from that good; and the effect is use...
The conjunction of the Celestial and Spiritual Kingdoms through the good of love. Signified.
That a man should not be admitted into the truths of faith and the goods of love, except in so far as he can be kept in them to the end of life. General article.

There are two things which make conjunction, the good of love and the truth of faith; the good of love is from the Lord immediately... The good of love is that through which the Lord leads man, and the truth of faith is that through which man is led... God, therefore, conjoins Himself with man through the good of love; and man conjoins himself with God as from himself through the truth of faith... The Lord continually inflows with the full good of love; yet He cannot be conjoined with the man in the full truth of faith, but only in that which is with the man...

At this day in the Christian world scarcely anyone is in the good of celestial love... and therefore the good of love cannot pass immediately from man to the celestial Angels, but it passes mediately through the spiritual Angels...
